claims.quote: Ukraine has repeatedly demonstrated it is serious about peace, but Russia has repeatedly rejected full and partial ceasefires while continuing attacks on Ukrainian civilians and energy.
claims.statement: Ukraine has repeatedly demonstrated it is serious about peace, while Russia has repeatedly rejected full and partial ceasefires and continued attacks on Ukrainian civilians and energy.

claims.statement: Russia could end the war in Ukraine today.

A UK government spokesperson made a statement on the UK's position regarding the agreement.

facts.quote: We will continue working closely with international partners to ensure Ukraine has the military and financial support it needs to defend itself.
facts.statement: The UK intends to continue working closely with international partners to ensure Ukraine has the military and financial support it needs to defend itself.

facts.quote: We will also maintain pressure on Russia through the toughest sanctions regime ever imposed by the UK
facts.statement: The UK intends to maintain pressure on Russia through its sanctions regime.

facts.quote: We remain committed to supporting Ukraine for as long as it takes and to working with partners to bring about a durable peace.
facts.statement: The UK remains committed to supporting Ukraine for as long as it takes and to working with partners to bring about a durable peace.

facts.quote: The UK fully supports US-led efforts to secure a just and lasting peace in Ukraine and remains in close contact with the US, Ukraine and other allies in support of that objective.
